name: Close Popover
purpose: Cancels the OnTimer script, closes the popover and leaves the current field.

name: Close PopOver At Next Idle
purpose: Installs a 0.5 second OnTimer that calls Close Popover.

name: Set Selection Position to 1
purpose: Sets the text cursor selection to position 1.

name: Delete Portal Row No Dialog
purpose: Deletes the current portal row without a confirmation dialog.
writes: delete: <portal table of the current portal row> (Delete Portal Row step 1, portal row, no dialog)
open_question: Which portal and table are affected depends on where the cursor is.
